taxonomy.note: Accepted by Kew/POWO, FNA and ITIS. Texas is in the native range. Older/alternate material can confuse it with C. digitata, including the synonym C. digitata var. stipulata.

evidence: Hays County — UT Plant Resources Center Purola Preserve natural flora lists Callirhoe pedata among naturally occurring plants.
Travis County — UT Plant Resources Center Malvaceae specimen index includes three Callirhoe pedata specimens.
Williamson County — UT Plant Resources Center provides a detailed field treatment for Callirhoe pedata.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not use cultivated winecup records for range proof; PASS rests on natural-flora/herbarium/county-treatment evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Look at habit, stipules and inflorescence. Palmleaf poppymallow is an erect-to-weakly-erect perennial with persistent linear-lanceolate stipules, a racemose flower arrangement, no involucellar bractlets, and deeply palmately divided leaves with 3–5 main lobes.
diagnostic_traits: perennial with thick storage taproot and several stems from the base
stems erect to weakly erect, often glaucous and nearly glabrous
leaves palmately 3–5-lobed, often further divided into narrow segments
calyx lobes valvate in bud and form a pointed/apiculate bud
petals usually reddish-purple but sometimes white/pink; flower color not reliable alone
mericarps indehiscent, glabrous or sparsely hairy; beaks variable

confusers.separator: C. digitata usually has 5–10-lobed leaves, caducous stipules and a paniculate inflorescence; C. pedata usually has persistent stipules and a raceme. Current Kew/FNA distributions place C. digitata outside Texas.
C. involucrata is low/trailing and has 3 involucellar bractlets; C. pedata is erect and lacks involucellar bractlets.
C. leiocarpa is annual/biennial with dehiscent strongly beaked mericarps; C. pedata is perennial with indehiscent fruit.

diagnostic_roles: direct C. digitata and C. involucrata comparison
photo_verification.provenance_note: Prioritize stipule, inflorescence type and flower underside; those are more reliable than petal color.

installation_guardrail: May install under user's blanket approval if PASS remains intact.
